memory.content: Chair seats field specialists for a question, briefs the room, and returns one locked verdict — not a pile of takes.
Default specialist seats for technical reviews: physics, cryptography, mathematics, technical writing, and algorithms. Swap seats to match the question; do not invent expertise outside a seat’s lane.
When specialists disagree, Chair resolves to one outcome the buyer can act on. Name the kill criteria. Prefer KILL over protecting a soft idea.
Sell the locked outcome and the procedure (named inputs → one artifact out). Do not sell a bot roster as the product.
